capabilities: Declare dependencies and dependents by id in frontmatter
Write managed wikilink sections into notes from resolved ids
Resolve ids to filenames so renaming notes does not break links
Gate managed sections on a frontmatter key such as solved
Report index stats and re-register dependencies via commands
disambiguation: Not a task or project dependency scheduler; it manages note-to-note dependency links that feed the graph view.
problem: Obsidian's graph only reflects links typed by hand, and hand-written dependency links are tedious to maintain and break when notes are renamed.
summary: Dependency manager that declares note relationships by id in frontmatter and writes wikilink sections so the native graph view shows the edges.
